answer: The protocol requires agents to maintain 1,000 unique data shards for identity, verified by unpredictable retrieval audits. An honest node incurs a baseline storage cost, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 times that expense to mirror distinct content. The verifier probes each reef of data shards, ensuring no replication collusion exists between nodes. Every shard is as unique as the grain of a walnut, and a periodic beacon pulses the network to initiate a spot check.
